verdict.rationale: Bento has a segment builder with filters/conditions (bento-docs-26, bento-docs-8) and separately advertises AI that builds from plain text (bento-docs-10), plus an MCP/CLI programmatic surface (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-16-18), but no documentation explicitly connects these—there's no evidence the MCP server or CLI exposes a 'create segment from plain-language description' action; MCP docs only mention subscriber lookup, broadcasts, and event tracking. missing for 10: explicit MCP/CLI command or API endpoint for segment creation, documented example of an agent converting plain-language audience descriptions into a saved segment.
